column8: baseline — cargo audit not installed; 650 tests pass; 0 clippy warnings
No algorithm confusion: SPKI from DB (not attacker JWK); no "none" path; ML-DSA has length guard; cross-type confusion rejected by crypto lib
AcmeError::Database(e.to_string()) → full sqlx error string in HTTP 500 detail field; exposes table names / SQL fragments to clients
All IDs are UUID v4 (random 128-bit); every KID-authenticated endpoint checks account_id ownership; unauthenticated cert GET is RFC-compliant

get_account_profile_grants, get_eab, get_stats use "any authenticated role"; inconsistent with attack surface map which lists Admin/Auditor; no authentication bypass (OperatorContext still enforces valid session)
AuditEventType::SecurityViolation defined and handled by FAU_ARP.1 alarm, but never emitted from any route handler; the alarm can never trigger
HS256/384/512 only; constant-time HMAC via OpenSSL; kid, url, payload thumbprint all verified before MAC check

get_by_kid fetches EAB key outside transaction; two concurrent new-account requests with same (kid,hmac) can both pass used_at IS NULL check and both create accounts; mark_used UPDATE lacks WHERE used_at IS NULL guard

AcmeError::Database / Crypto / Internal / Builder / Mtc all call to_string() / carry internal messages; all map to IntoResponse via detail = self.to_string() — DB errors include sqlx driver detail, crypto errors include openssl detail

is_blocked_ip check only guards redirect targets; ip-type identifiers (192.168.x, 10.x, etc.) are offered http-01 challenges and the initial GET to the private IP is not blocked; allows probing internal HTTP services
All QueryBuilder calls use push (static SQL) + push_bind (parameterised values); no user data pushed as raw SQL; sqlx prevents injection by construction
set_certificate UPDATE lacks WHERE status = 'ready'; two concurrent finalize requests can each sign and commit a certificate for the same order; first cert becomes orphaned in DB
cargo-audit not installed; unable to scan for known CVEs; recommend installing and running in CI
32-byte getrandom (CSPRNG); hex-encoded 64-char token; 256-bit entropy; subtle::ConstantTimeEq for lookup

When max_body_bytes = 0, code calls DefaultBodyLimit::disable() instead of keeping axum 2 MiB default as comment states; default config is 65536 so not triggered in default deployments; manual misconfiguration needed
No contact/email/HMAC keys logged; audit principal uses JWK thumbprint (opaque) or operator name; tracing calls use structured fields without sensitive values
key_change handler emits no audit event; account key replacement is a critical security action with no repudiation trail; no AuditEventType::KeyChange variant exists
AuthChallengeOk and AuthChallengeFail emitted from validation/mod.rs on_valid/on_invalid; order creation emits OrderCreate; revocation emits CertRevoke
